entry.title: Article 29: Debt exclusion to renovate Town Hall/Ritter Memorial into a Meeting House with a: Town Meeting, 2025-05-03
entry.summary: Marshall Park renovation (Article 28). A debt-exclusion request to renovate Marshall Park; a reduced-scope alternative was also costed out; the parks commission had returned $1.5 million in state grants it could not match in time.

entry.title: Article 29: Debt exclusion to renovate Town Hall/Ritter Memorial into a Meeting House with a: Finance Committee, 2025-04-03
entry.summary: Municipal building / Ritter Memorial renovation debt exclusion (Article 34). A debt exclusion to renovate town hall into a meeting house and expand Ritter building for municipal and school offices; residents raised concerns about unknown future operating costs and contingency adequacy.
